scene: A voice whispers destinations, unfolding transport portals along the busy mistway.
picture: Flat side-view along a glowing platform. On the far left, a sleek hover metro waits with open doors. Left of centre, the silver-haired grandmother in pink tracksuit holds the phone receiver inside the red booth, dog beside her. On the right, a turquoise flying scooter idles. Far right, a gilded gondola drone bobs.
shown: a sleek hover metro with open doors waiting on the platform far left
a turquoise flying scooter idling beside a robotic attendant on the right
